title: SAGE: Stochastic Prompt Optimization via Agent-Guided Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2606.18902v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Context engineering has emerged as a primary lever for improving AI systems without parameter updates. Recent work showing that textual gradients do not function as real gradients motivates treating automatic prompt optimization (APO) as black-box search. We introduce SPO (Stochastic Prompt Optimization), a framework for stochastic search over prompt space, and compare three strategies of increasing sophistication: error-informed random search, a genetic algorithm with evolutionary operators, and SAGE (SPO via Agent-Guided Exploration), a multi-agent pipeline with diagnostic code execution. Across three benchmarks, no single strategy dominates; effectiveness depends on the interaction of landscape structure with error type. We further deploy SAGE on a mental-health chatbot under a continuous optimization paradigm, where it compounds eight cycles of individually-noisy A/B tests into a statistically robust gain in next-day retention. translated_title: SAGE：基于智能体引导探索的随机提示优化
translated_abstract: 上下文工程已成为在不更新模型参数的情况下改进AI系统的主要手段。近期研究表明，文本梯度并不像真实梯度那样发挥作用，这促使我们将自动提示优化（APO）视为黑盒搜索问题。我们提出了SPO（随机提示优化）框架，用于在提示空间中进行随机搜索，并比较了三种复杂度递增的策略：基于错误信息的随机搜索、带有进化算子的遗传算法，以及SAGE（通过智能体引导探索实现SPO）——一个具备诊断性代码执行能力的多智能体流水线。在三个基准测试中，没有任何单一策略能够全面占优；其有效性取决于搜索空间结构与错误类型之间的交互作用。我们进一步在心理健康聊天机器人上以持续优化范式部署了SAGE，它将八轮各自噪声较大的A/B测试累积转化为次日留存率在统计上稳健的提升。
tldr: 提出SPO随机提示优化框架，比较三种搜索策略后发现无单一方法全面占优，而其中的SAGE多智能体方法在心理健康聊天机器人的持续优化中，将多轮噪声A/B测试累积为次日留存率的统计显著提升。
en_tdlr: SAGE introduces a stochastic prompt optimization framework comparing three search strategies, finding no single strategy dominates across benchmarks, while its multi-agent approach compounds eight cycles of noisy A/B tests into statistically robust next-day retention gains on a mental-health chatbot.
